title: Data Augmentation for Personal Knowledge Base Population
benchmark_measurement: The ability of a knowledge base population system to extract the 'religion' attribute from text. The benchmark measured the recall of extracting protected attributes, including religion, comparing a baseline model on the TACRED dataset with an augmented version.
base_benchmarks: NIST TAC Knowledge Base Population (KBP) challenges
TAC KBP 2015 cold start slot filling task
findings: The data augmentation method significantly improved the recall for extracting protected attributes like religion. The baseline TACRED model had a recall of 0.095 for protected attributes, while the proposed solution achieved a recall of 0.99. The paper explicitly mentions that the religion of Bill Clinton, which was missed by the baseline model, was successfully extracted by their augmented model.
